# Online Boutique - Kubernetes Production Deployment
# Source: GoogleCloudPlatform/microservices-demo
#
# Includes:
# - Dedicated namespace
# - 10 application microservices
# - Redis cart storage with persistent volume
# - Optional load generator (disabled by default)
# - Internal ClusterIP services
# - External frontend LoadBalancer
# - CPU and memory resource constraints
# - Liveness, readiness, and startup probes
# - Non-root security contexts
# - Horizontal Pod Autoscalers
# - Pod Disruption Budgets
# - Network Policies
#
# Images use the published v0.10.7 release.
# For production, replace image tags with validated immutable digests.
# External production traffic should use a TLS-enabled ingress/gateway.
# Redis is single-instance; use managed/HA Redis for production availability.

apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: online-boutique
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: online-boutique
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: online-boutique
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/audit: restricted
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn: restricted

---
# Default service account for application workloads.
# Kubernetes API token mounting is disabled.

apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: boutique-app
  namespace: online-boutique
automountServiceAccountToken: false

---
# Redis persistent storage.
# Requires a default StorageClass.

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: redis-cart
  namespace: online-boutique
  labels:
    app: redis-cart
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: redis-cart
  ports:
    - name: redis
      port: 6379
      targetPort: 6379
      protocol: TCP

---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: redis-cart
  namespace: online-boutique
  labels:
    app: redis-cart
spec:
  serviceName: redis-cart
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis-cart
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: redis-cart
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: boutique-app
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 999
        runAsGroup: 999
        fsGroup: 999
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: redis
          image: redis:7.4.2-alpine
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command:
            - redis-server
          args:
            - --appendonly
            - "yes"
            - --dir
            - /data
            - --save
            - "60"
            - "1"
          ports:
            - name: redis
              containerPort: 6379
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
          startupProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: redis
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 12
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: redis
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: redis
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          volumeMounts:
            - name: redis-data
              mountPath: /data
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: redis-data
      spec:
        accessModes:
          - ReadWriteOnce
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 10Gi

---
# Ad Service
# Java / gRPC / 9555

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: adservice
  namespace: online-boutique
  labels:
    app: adservice
spec:
  replicas: 2
  revisionHistoryLimit: 5
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: adservice
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: adservice
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: boutique-app
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: adservice
          image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/online-boutique-ci/microservices-demo/adservice:v0.10.7
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: grpc
              containerPort: 9555
          env:
            - name: PORT
              value: "9555"
            - name: DISABLE_PROFILER
              value: "1"
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: "1"
              memory: 512Mi
          startupProbe:
            grpc:
              port: 9555
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 30
          readinessProbe:
            grpc:
              port: 9555
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            grpc:
              port: 9555
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: adservice
  namespace: online-boutique
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: adservice
  ports:
    - name: grpc
      port: 9555
      targetPort: grpc

# Frontend
# Go / HTTP / 8080
# All application service addresses are configured explicitly.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: frontend
  namespace: online-boutique
  labels:
    app: frontend
spec:
  replicas: 3
  revisionHistoryLimit: 5
  minReadySeconds: 5
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: frontend
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: frontend
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: boutique-app
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: frontend
          image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/online-boutique-ci/microservices-demo/frontend:v0.10.7
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
          env:
            - name: PORT
              value: "8080"
            - name: PRODUCT_CATALOG_SERVICE_ADDR
              value: "productcatalogservice:3550"
            - name: CURRENCY_SERVICE_ADDR
              value: "currencyservice:7000"
            - name: CART_SERVICE_ADDR
              value: "cartservice:7070"
            - name: RECOMMENDATION_SERVICE_ADDR
              value: "recommendationservice:8080"
            - name: SHIPPING_SERVICE_ADDR
              value: "shippingservice:50051"
            - name: CHECKOUT_SERVICE_ADDR
              value: "checkoutservice:5050"
            - name: AD_SERVICE_ADDR
              value: "adservice:9555"
            - name: ENABLE_PROFILER
              value: "0"
            - name: ENV_PLATFORM
              value: "local"
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 150m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /_healthz
              port: http
              httpHeaders:
                - name: Cookie
                  value: "shop_session-id=x-startup-probe"
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 24
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /_healthz
              port: http
              httpHeaders:
                - name: Cookie
                  value: "shop_session-id=x-readiness-probe"
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 3
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /_healthz
              port: http
              httpHeaders:
                - name: Cookie
                  value: "shop_session-id=x-liveness-probe"
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 3
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true

---
# External frontend service.
# For production use behind a TLS-enabled ingress/gateway.
# Restrict public exposure using cloud firewall rules as required.

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: frontend-external
  namespace: online-boutique
  labels:
    app: frontend
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster
  selector:
    app: frontend
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
      protocol: TCP

---
# Load Generator
# Disabled by default.
# Set replicas to 1 only for controlled performance testing.
# Not recommended for normal production traffic.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: loadgenerator
  namespace: online-boutique
  labels:
    app: loadgenerator
spec:
  replicas: 0
  revisionHistoryLimit: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: loadgenerator
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: loadgenerator
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: boutique-app
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: loadgenerator
          image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/online-boutique-ci/microservices-demo/loadgenerator:v0.10.7
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          env:
            - name: FRONTEND_ADDR
              value: "frontend:80"
            - name: USERS
              value: "10"
            - name: RATE
              value: "1"
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true

---
# Horizontal Pod Autoscaling
# Requires Kubernetes Metrics Server.
# Autoscalers manage replica counts after deployment.

apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: frontend-hpa
  namespace: online-boutique
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: frontend
  minReplicas: 3
  maxReplicas: 10
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 70
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
      policies:
        - type: Pods
          value: 1
          periodSeconds: 60
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 30
      policies:
        - type: Pods
          value: 2
          periodSeconds: 60

---
# Network Policies
# Requires a CNI plugin with NetworkPolicy enforcement.
# Namespace traffic is isolated by default.
# Allow internal application communication, DNS, frontend ingress,
# and external HTTPS for services that require outbound connectivity.

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny
  namespace: online-boutique
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
    - Egress

---
# Allow application pods to communicate inside their own namespace.
# The Redis policy below further restricts Redis ingress.

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-internal-services
  namespace: online-boutique
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchExpressions:
      - key: app
        operator: NotIn
        values:
          - redis-cart
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
    - Egress
  ingress:
    - from:
        - podSelector: {}
  egress:
    - to:
        - podSelector: {}

---
# Only cartservice may connect to Redis.

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: redis-restricted-access
  namespace: online-boutique
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis-cart
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
    - Egress
  ingress:
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: cartservice
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 6379

---
# DNS resolution for application pods.

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-dns
  namespace: online-boutique
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
    - Egress
  egress:
    - to:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system
      ports:
        - protocol: UDP
          port: 53
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 53

---
# Public HTTP ingress is permitted only to frontend.
# Production TLS termination must be configured at the edge.

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-frontend-ingress
  namespace: online-boutique
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: frontend
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
  ingress:
    - ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 8080

---
# Allow external HTTPS calls for applications that fetch external data.
# Egress restrictions should be tightened to approved destinations
# using a compatible CNI, firewall, or egress gateway.

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-external-https
  namespace: online-boutique
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchExpressions:
      - key: app
        operator: In
        values:
          - currencyservice
          - frontend
  policyTypes:
    - Egress
  egress:
    - ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 443

---
# Namespace resource governance.
# Adjust to match workload benchmarking and node capacity.

apiVersion: v1
kind: ResourceQuota
metadata:
  name: boutique-resource-quota
  namespace: online-boutique
spec:
  hard:
    requests.cpu: "20"
    requests.memory: 24Gi
    limits.cpu: "40"
    limits.memory: 48Gi
    pods: "80"
    persistentvolumeclaims: "5"
    requests.storage: 100Gi
    services.loadbalancers: "2"

---
# Default resource requirements for any additional containers.

apiVersion: v1
kind: LimitRange
metadata:
  name: boutique-limit-range
  namespace: online-boutique
spec:
  limits:
    - type: Container
      defaultRequest:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 128Mi
      default:
        cpu: 500m
        memory: 512Mi
      min:
        cpu: 25m
        memory: 32Mi
      max:
        cpu: "2"
        memory: 2Gi
